s: Kafka Streams, Flink, real-time analytics, CDC
d: Stream processing handles data in real-time as it arrives — not in batches. Kafka Streams, Apache Flink, and Change Data Capture (CDC) enable real-time analytics, fraud detection, live dashboards, and event-driven architectures at massive scale.

p: Streaming is a critical component of modern backend architecture. It focuses on optimizing performance, ensuring reliability, and scaling the system to handle increasing loads efficiently. Mastering this allows you to build enterprise-grade applications.
1. Understand the core principles and trade-offs.
2. Evaluate open-source tools and industry standards.
3. Implement the pattern within your backend stack.
4. Monitor performance and adjust configurations as scale increases.
